latin: Idea lapidis non est aliud quam lapis productus a diuino intellectu in esse intelligibili, quod est esse secundum quid, existens in mente diuina sicut cognitum in cognoscente.
translation: The idea of a stone is nothing other than the stone as brought forth by the divine intellect into intelligible being — a qualified mode of being — present in the divine mind in the way that a known thing is present in the one who knows it.
